name: TypeScript
description: TypeScript type system mastery: basic types and interfaces, generics, type narrowing and guards, advanced mapped/conditional types, declaration files, strict mode configuration, React-specific typing patterns, tsconfig tuning, and type-level programming.

subskills.name: Types, Interfaces & Aliases
subskills.description: Primitive types, interface vs type alias, union/intersection types, literal types, optional properties.

subskills.name: Generics
subskills.description: Generic functions, generic constraints (extends), utility types (Partial, Required, Pick, Omit, Record).

subskills.name: Type Narrowing & Guards
subskills.description: typeof guards, instanceof, discriminated unions, user-defined type guards (is keyword), assertion functions.

subskills.name: Advanced Types
subskills.description: Mapped types, conditional types (infer), template literal types, indexed access types.

subskills.name: Declaration Files
subskills.description: .d.ts files, ambient declarations, DefinitelyTyped (@types/*), module augmentation.

subskills.name: Strict Mode Configuration
subskills.description: strict flag family: strictNullChecks, noImplicitAny, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, exactOptionalPropertyTypes.

subskills.name: TypeScript with React
subskills.description: FC typing, generic component props, event handler types, useRef typing, forwardRef, children typing.

subskills.name: TSConfig & Module Resolution
subskills.description: tsconfig.json options, paths/baseUrl aliases, moduleResolution (node/bundler), target/lib settings.

subskills.name: Type-Level Programming
subskills.description: Recursive types, branded/opaque types, type-safe builders, complex inference chains.

cv.signal: Type system architecture or library typing

junior.description: Defines interfaces, configures tsconfig properly, and works with strict null checks enabled.

mid.description: Writes generic utilities, implements type guards for safe narrowing, and types React components idiomatically.

senior.description: Designs complex mapped/conditional types, writes declaration files for untyped libraries, and implements type-level logic.
